scientific_integrity: A direct elementary chain-level proof; no independence or external certification claimed. The field-enumeration program is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the top homology fixed subgroup for the projective linear group with trivial coefficient action. Does not determine complete representations, larger symmetry groups, or non-Desarguesian planes. The primary source publisher dates the 1992 print edition to 5 March 1992.
title: The characteristic-two fixed-class dichotomy in projective matroid homology
